observations.claim: On 2026-02-20 documentation removed Live Wallpaper and voice directory references while expanding consciousness, Genesis and safety descriptions, showing active component retirement and architecture churn rather than a monotonic additive system history.

On 2026-02-21 the project corrected Frank's self-description to persistent cross-session memory and fuller email capability, removed wake-word and wallpaper references, trimmed identity_core, and reverted personality traits toward less hard-coded/emergent behavior. The same change left former wallpaper trigger functions as explicit no-ops.

The 2026-03-04 commit documents an intention-to-action-to-reflection sequence across consciousness, spatial state and NeRD physics, with the claimed closure occurring through shared spatial state injected into later model context rather than a direct intention-to-action API. This is evidence for a historical re-entry architecture motif, not proof of causal emergence or phenomenal consciousness.

On 2026-03-10 documentation replaced the autonomous entity system with Rooms and simultaneously added/foregrounded Thalamus, Subconscious, Neural Conscience, ThoughtSeedVAE, Nucleus Accumbens, Hypothesis Engine, Experiment Lab and other subsystems; model routing documentation also changed to a shared GPU slot and 3-tier routing.

On 2026-03-19 papers were rewritten again to current architecture, changing entity references to rooms, revising model descriptions to Qwen2.5-3B, changing UI assumptions, and removing historical-note caveats from papers. This creates a concrete lineage hazard: later documentation can overwrite the apparent historical state if commit provenance is not retained.

requirements.txt at 2026-03-19 contains openwakeword>=0.6,<1.0 even though the 2026-02-21 architecture change explicitly removed wake-word as a capability. The dependency remains present at frozen HEAD. Dependency presence therefore cannot be treated as proof that a capability is active.

Recent peer receipts already establish visual-backend/self-model drift and Retina-to-NativeVision lineage. This shard does not re-credit that work; it generalizes the same failure class across architecture documentation, model identity, service retirement, dependencies and runtime self-description.

synthesis.primary_finding: Project-Frankenstein's history contains repeated temporal truth drift: documentation, training/self-knowledge text, dependency lists, code stubs and runtime topology changed at different rates. A single present-tense 'architecture fact' cannot safely be inferred from any one of those surfaces.
synthesis.lineage_rule: Never destructively normalize older architecture docs into current truth. Preserve claim-level SUPERSEDED/CURRENT status with commit/time provenance and explicit transition edges.
synthesis.frank_v0_1_implication: Frank's self-model must be generated from current versioned runtime/capability receipts plus durable identity state, not from stale feature-training ground truth or dependency/file presence alone. This applies to vision, voice, memory, email, model backend and every tool/service.

contradictions.b: 2026-03-19 requirements adds openwakeword and frozen HEAD still contains the dependency.
contradictions.non_resolution: No code-path or service-start evidence in this shard establishes whether openwakeword is active, dead, experimental or merely stale.
contradictions.next_test: Trace imports/startup/service enablement and perform an actual wake-word reachability/effect test before assigning capability status.

counterhypotheses.claim: Documentation churn may have been editorial only and not reflect runtime topology changes.
counterhypotheses.resolution: Some changes are clearly documentation-only, so runtime claims must remain unpromoted without code or effect evidence. The historical value of the shard is precisely the divergence between surfaces.

The March 4 sequence can be fully explained by shared-state context priming rather than a stronger emergent intention mechanism.
counterhypotheses.next_test: Truthful-vs-shuffled-vs-lesioned spatial re-entry replay with matched prompts and locomotion state.
